name: TG Hub logo — redesign brief
purpose: Generate a more stylish TG Hub logo with an OpenAI image model, while keeping what makes today's logo recognisable. Each direction below is a ready request; generate several per direction, pick one, then have it redrawn as a clean vector.

chosen_logo.description: Adopted 2026-10-25: a blue (#0089FB) tile with chamfered corners holding a white, forward-leaning TG monogram whose G encloses a play triangle; HUB in heavy charcoal (white on dark) capitals; TN as a small blue superscript.
chosen_logo.usage: Header: compact, following the site theme. Footer and admin sidebar: dark artwork always (they are dark in both themes).

current_logo.description: A red rounded square (#E10600, corners ≈ 19% of the side) holding a white "TG" in Montserrat ExtraBold, followed by "HUB" in charcoal capitals and a tiny grey "TN" region tag. Clean but generic: plain font, plain square, no idea of its own.

brief.brand: TG Hub — Tunisian Gaming Hub: one place for game news, tournaments, PC checks, a gear marketplace and squads, for players in Tunisia.
brief.goal: Keep the red-tile-with-TG idea, but give the mark a drawn idea of its own so it looks designed, not typed: a custom monogram, a confident silhouette, sharper energy.
brief.references_for_quality: The polish of real esports and game-platform brands — FACEIT, start.gg, Riot Games, Valorant, repeat.gg — not their shapes.
must_keep: The letters TG as the mark, white on red
The red #E10600 as the main colour
The word HUB next to the mark
TN as a small secondary region tag
Flat shapes that still read as a 16 px favicon and in one colour
free_to_change: The letter shapes of T and G (custom-drawn, joined, cut)
The tile's silhouette (cut corners, angled edges) as long as it stays a compact tile
The HUB lettering (custom cuts, tighter or wider spacing)
How the TN tag is styled

palette.rule: Red does the work; charcoal and white support it; gold only as a tiny accent if at all.

avoid: Gradients, neon glow, chrome, bevels, 3D, glossy highlights, drop shadows
Game controllers, joysticks, swords, shields, crowns, wings, flames, skulls, mascots
A literal Tunisian flag, star or full crescent badge
Italic or slanted lettering, script, hand-drawn or grunge textures
Circles or hexagon badges around the mark
Taglines or any text other than TG, HUB and TN
Mock-ups: no walls, paper, phones, T-shirts or photos — just the logo on a plain background

directions.A_cut_corner_monogram: The tile loses one rounded corner for a sharp 45° cut (top-right), like a game-UI panel. T and G are drawn as one joined monogram: the T's crossbar runs straight into the top of the G.
directions.B_negative_space_play: Inside the red tile, the gap between the T's stem and the G's bar forms a small right-pointing triangle — a hidden play button that says games without a controller.
directions.C_crescent_g: The G is a thick, near-complete circle whose opening reads as a crisp crescent arc — a quiet nod to the Tunisian flag, no star, no badge.
directions.D_wordmark_blade: No separate tile: TGHUB as one bold custom wordmark, TG in red and HUB in charcoal, joined by one clean angled cut through the letters, with TN as a small red-outlined chip.

notes: No separate negative prompt exists, so what to avoid is written into each prompt.
Image models sometimes misspell text — n is 4 so you can keep one where TG, HUB and TN are exact.
Results are raster images for choosing a direction; the chosen one should be redrawn as a vector (SVG) before it replaces the site logo.
If gpt-image-1 has been superseded on your account, use the newest image model.

A_cut_corner_monogram.prompt: Professional esports brand logo for "TG Hub", a Tunisian gaming platform, flat vector, centred alone on a transparent background with generous empty space, horizontal lockup. On the left, a compact square tile in pure red #E10600: three corners slightly rounded, the top-right corner cut off with one sharp 45-degree chamfer like a modern game-interface panel. Inside the tile, a custom white #FFFFFF monogram of the letters T and G drawn as one connected shape in a heavy geometric sans-serif: the crossbar of the T extends to the right and becomes the top stroke of the G, the G has a short flat horizontal spur, all stroke ends cut square and crisp, strokes thick and even, the monogram filling about 65% of the tile. To the right, the word "HUB" in heavy geometric capitals, charcoal #1F2123, tight confident spacing, cap height about 45% of the tile, vertically centred, with one subtle detail: the inner corners of the H and B cut at the same 45-degree angle as the tile. After HUB, a tiny rounded tag with "TN" in small bold capitals, red #E10600 text on light grey #EEF0F3. Polished like FACEIT or Riot Games branding. Exactly these characters: TG, HUB, TN. Flat solid colours only — no gradient, no glow, no shadow, no 3D, no texture, no controller or weapon icons, no mascot, no flag, no star, no tagline, no mock-up.
